Description

Join a team that puts people first, takes ownership, and helps the world connect beyond words.

 

Full time Benefits              

Paid Vacation Time and Paid Sick Time and Paid Holidays
401k 6% match with immediate vesting
Nationwide Medical Insurance plans and coverage (Medical, Dental/Orthodontia, Vision)
Virtual care options
HSA company match
3 Medical plan options including a Low Deductible PPO Medical Plan Offering
Employee Assistance Program
Engaged Employee Resource Groups
Outstanding Learning and Career Development Opportunities

Pay Range: Actual pay may vary up or down depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for incentive compensation.

* Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the United States to be considered. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role *

 

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities Required

Demonstrated ability to develop software solutions using modern programming languages such as C#, TypeScript, or JavaScript.
Ability to develop automation tools and scripts to improve operational efficiency and system reliability.
Basic understanding of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, NAT, firewalls, client-server architectures, and network troubleshooting.
Familiarity with Linux and Windows operating systems.
Willingness to learn VoIP technologies including SIP, RTP, WebRTC, and related communications infrastructure.
Ability to investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions.
Effective use of AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, code quality, and problem-solving.
Ability to collaborate effectively within a team, including participating in code reviews and incorporating feedback.
Familiarity with software engineering best practices, including source control, automated testing, code quality, and documentation.
Willingness to support production environments, including participation in deployment activities and occasional after-hours support when necessary.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and software design skills.
Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies and concepts.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet established deadlines, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Experience/Education/Certifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
Professional software development experience is not required; relevant internships, coursework, personal projects, or open-source contributions are valued.
Familiarity with developing software using C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, or similar programming languages.
Exposure to developing and maintaining automated tests.
Working knowledge of source control systems (Git preferred).
Understanding of infrastructure-as-code concepts and practices.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with VoIP technologies including SIP, RTP, or WebRTC.
Development of applications using WebSockets or other real-time communication protocols.
Experience with IP networking analysis and packet capture tools such as Wireshark.
Exposure to open-source real-time communications platforms such as OpenSIPS, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, or coTURN.
Experience using AI-assisted software development tools.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as using GitHub Actions.
Exposure to infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or OpenTofu.
Working knowledge of Linux and Docker containers.
Familiarity with AWS services such as EC2, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Route 53, etc.

Other General Requirements/Additional Notes

Physical Demands
Able to sit/ stand for a long period of time in an office environment
Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, tools, and to handle other computer components
Lifting and transporting of moderately heavy objects, such as computers and peripherals
Must be able to lift a minimum of 50 pounds
Regular and predictable attendance required.
Positive attitude, team player, good interpersonal communication skills and able to work across company departments.
This position has access to highly confidential, sensitive information relating to the employees and customers of Sorenson Communications. It is essential that applicant possess the requisite integrity to maintain the information in strictest confidence.

 

Equal Employment Opportunity:
Sorenson Communications is an Equal Opportunity, Affirmative Action Employer.

 

Company Summary

Our Mission…Harnessing the power of language, we connect diverse people and enrich the human experience.   

Our Vision…To provide global language services that expand opportunities, nurture belonging, and empower the world to connect beyond words.   

As one of the world’s leading language services providers, Sorenson combines patented technology with human-centric solutions. We strive to increase diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility for underrepresented people through communication solutions for all: call captioning and video relay services, over-video and in-person sign language and spoken language interpreting, translation, real-time captioning, and post-production language services.

Sorenson’s impact vision and plan extends to supporting employment opportunities for diverse employees, customers, and communities.  As a minority-owned company, we are committed to expanding opportunities for underserved communities while promoting an inclusive workplace for our own employees.
